answer: To deter Sybils, our network anchors identity to cryptographic stake burning via superlinear cost scaling: registering $k$ agents requires burning $\beta \cdot k^{1.5}$ tokens, an escalating economic canyon an adversary cannot bridge. This exponential penalty ensures multi-identity attacks quickly become mathematically ruinous.
